description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to contribute to high-quality patient care and support our nursing team.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in assisting the Director of Nursing with the overall management of the nursing department, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for an individual with strong clinical skills and a commitment to excellence. A Registered Nurse (RN) license is preferred for this vital leadership position, with a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license is preferred
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility
Prior supervisory or leadership experience in a healthcare setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
